human_check_steps:
# Check: only zh, ja, en on after install (A04-aster924)

Mac
1. Build and install from master: `scripts/install.sh` (it restarts Tatakikun; quit and reopen VS Code/Slack afterwards).
2. To see a fresh install, clear your saved choice: `defaults delete com.tatakikun.inputmethod.Tatakikun languagesOff` (skip this to check that your own choice is kept), then `launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.tatakikun.inputmethod.Tatakikun`.
3. Open the Tatakikun input menu in the menu bar: only English, 中文 and 日本語 are checked; Español, Français, हिन्दी, বাংলা, العربية are listed but unchecked.
4. In TextEdit type `houxuan`, then `2`: the second candidate is inserted (not a digit added to the input).
5. Check العربية in the menu, then type `7abibi`: حبيبي is offered (turning it on still works).

Phones (optional)
6. Android: install the new APK on a phone or emulator with no earlier Tatakikun data; settings > Language packs shows English · 中文 · 日本語 (3).
7. iOS: fresh install in the Simulator; the app's language list has only English, 中文, 日本語 on.
